text:
You come under the cosmic influence of number 1. Symbolised by the sun, number-1 is the basis of all the numbers and of the life itself.  Hence, it gives creativity, and positiveness (definite in views but in consequence sometimes obstinacy.  It makes you ambitious, disliking restraint and gives an urge to rise in your sphere.  There is a desire to become the head of family circle/among fellow beings and keep your authority.  You are respected and looked upto by your associates. 
       People lucky for you are those born on 1,10,19,28,4,13,22,31 of any month, especially if born from 21st July to 21st August or from 21st March to 21st April.  The persons whose name adds upto 1,2 or 7 can alsobe lucky for  you.          
       Lucky dates for you are - 1, 10, 19, 28 of every month.  Secondary lucky dates are 4, 13, 22 and 31. 
       Days of week auspicious for you are Sundays and Mondays.   
       Fortunate colours are all shades of gold, yellow, browns and golden-brown. 
       Lucky jewels to be worn next to the skin are yellow diamond,  topaz or amber. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with             your birth number are A,I,J,Q and Y. 
       Sensitive parts of your body are blood circulatory organs or eyes.  Principle herbs and fruits related with your number are raisins, saffron,cloves, nutmeg, barley and honey. 
       Important years of your life are 28, 37, 46, 55, 64, 73.

You come under the cosmic influence of number 2.  Symbolised by the Moon, number 2 gives a gentle, imaginative, artistic and romantic nature.  However, the qualities are moremental than physical.  You are not as forceful in carrying out your ideas.  You should be conscious of being restless and uncertain, lack of continuity of your plans and ideas, over-sensitiveness and lack of self-confidence. 
       People lucky for you are those born on 2,11,20,29,7,16,25,especially if born between 20th June to 21st July.  The persons whose name number adds up to 2,7 or 1 can also 
       be lucky for you.  
       Lucky dates for you are 2,11,20,29.  Secondary lucky dates are 7,16,25. 
       Days of week auspicious for you are Mondays, Sundays and Fridays. 
       Fortunate colours are all shades of green, cream and white. 
       Lucky jewels to be worn next to the skin are pearls, jades and moonstones. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your birth number are B,K  and R. 
       Sensitive parts of your body are digestive organs which should be taken care of in general.  Principle herbs and fruits related with your number are lettuce, cabbages, turnips, cucumber, melon, chicory or endive. 
       Important years of your life are 29, 38, 47, 56, 65 and 74.

You come under the cosmic infuence of number-3. Symbolised by the Jupiter,No.-3 individuals are decidely  ambitious, aiming to rise in the world ,want control and authority over others. Love order and discipline in all things. Excellent in execution of commands, fit for positions of trust and responsibility (being extremely conscious in carrying out their duty. They like independence and sometimes even dictatorial in their behaviour.  They are though not quarrelsome yet succeed in making enemies due to above excesses which should be controlled.          People lucky for you are those born on 3,12,21,30 of any month, moreso,if born between 19th February to 20th March or from 21st November to 20th December.  The persons whose name number adds upto 3,6 or 9 can also be lucky for you. 
       Your lucky dates are 3,12,21 or 30 of every month. Days of week  auspicious for you are Thursdays, Fridays and Tuesdays.Fortunate colours are all shades of mauve, violet or purple besides all shades of blue, crimson and rose. Lucky jewels tobe worn next to the skin are amethyst or violet saphire. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your birth number are C,G,L or S. 
       Sensitive parts of your body are nervous system, generally brought on by overwork and their desire not  to spare themselves in anything they do.  Principle herbs and fruits related with your number are cherries, lharberries, straw-berries, apples, mulberries, peaches, pomegranates, pine-apples, saffron, cloves, almonds, figs and wheat. 
       Important years of your life are 21, 30, 39, 48, 57, 66 and 75.

You come under the cosmic influence of number-4.  Symbolised by the Uranus, the planet of originality, number-4 natives are distinct from all others.  They are attracted to social questions and reforms of all kinds.  They are very positive and original in their views and opinions to the extent of questioning the established rules and regulations.  Always take opposite side in arguments.  Although not meaning to be quarrelsome yet bring about opposition and make a great number of secret enemies.  They should be conscious of being melancholy, highly strung and expressing their views too openly or frankly. 
       People lucky for you are those born on 4, 13, 22, 31 or 1, 10, 19 or 28 or any month, moreso if born between 21st June to 20th July or from 22nd July to the end of August.  Name of whose adds upto 4, 1 or 7 can also be lucky for you. 
       Days of week auspicious for you are Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays. Fortunate colours are electric-blue and grey. Lucky jewels to be worn next to the skin are light saphire and dark saphire which should be worn on above days.           
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your birth number are D, M or T.There is a likelihood of suffering from mysterious ailments, difficult of ordinary diagnosis.  You are more or less inclined to melancholia, anaemia and pains in the head and back.  Can derive greatest benefit from all pathies related with psychology etc. besides latest techniques. 
       Important years of your life are 22, 31, 40, 49, 58, 67 and 76. Your name number invariably should not add upto 4 rather some favourable number such as 1, 2 or 7.

You come under the cosmic influence of number-5.  Symbolised by the Mercury; number 5 individuals are mentally highly strong, quick in thoughts and decisions, born-speculators, impulsive in their actions and craving excitement.  They recover quickly from the heaviest blows of fate and have a uniformity or character throughout life.  They should be conscious against mental over-work, mental tension, to avoid nervous breakdown and becoming irritable. 
       People lucky for you are those born on 5, 14, 23 of any month especially if born from 21st May to 20th June and from 21st August to 20st September.  The persons whose name number adds upto 5 can also be lucky for you. 
       Your lucky dates are 5, 14 and 23 of every month. 
       Days of week auspicious for you are Wednesdays and Fridays. 
       Fortunate colours are all light shades especially light grey, white and all glistening materials. 
       Lucky jewels to be worn next tothe skin are diamonds which should be worn on Wednesday besides wearing ornaments made of platinum or silver. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your number are E, H, N and X. 
       They have a tendency to overstrain the nervous system.  Are inclined to attempt too much mentally, to live too much on their nerves.  Sleep, rest and quititude are the best medicines they can employ.  Principle herbs for you are carrots, bread, nuts of all kinds.        
       Important years of your life are 23, 32, 41, 50, 59, 68, 77.

You come under the cosmic influence of number-6.  Symbolised by the Venus; number-6 individuals are affectionate, sociable and romantic.  They love beautiful things, make artistic homes and are fond of art/music.  They are firm minded and unyieldy except when they are deeply attached to someone.  For such a person, they will fight to their death.  For their qualities they attract others and are loved rather worshipped by those around them. 
       People lucky for you are those born on 6, 15, 24 of any month especially if born between the period from 20th April to 20th May or 21st September to 20th October.  The persons whose name number adds upto 5, 6 or 9 can also be lucky for you. 
       Dates lucky for you are 6, 15,24 of any month. Days of week auspicious for you are Fridays, Thursdays and Tuesdays. Fortunate colours are all shades of blue, froms the lightest to the darkest, all shades of rose or pink. 
       Lucky jewels tobe worn next to the skin are turquoise or emeralds. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your number are U and V. 
       They are prone to trouble of throat, nose and upper part of the lungs.  As a rule, they have a robust constitution especially if they can live in the open air or in the country where they can have plenty of air and exercise.  Principle herbs etc. for your number are water-melon, beans, pomegranates, apples, peaches, figs, almonds and juice of rose leaves and violets.          
       Important years of your life are 24, 33,42, 51, 60, 69 and 78.

You come under the cosmic influence of number-7.  Symbolised by the Neptune, the planet of fantasy, such individuals are keenly interested in visiting foreign lands/reading foreign literature.  Have a peculiar philosophical outlook about life.  Care a little about material things of life and having rather peculiar ideals about religion.  They have often remarkable dreams and prophetic tongue.  They have got taste for reading strange books. 
       People lucky foar you are those born on 7, 16, 25, 2, 11, 20, 29 of any month, especially if born between 21st June to 20th July.  The persons whose name number adds upto 7 or 2 can also be lucky for you. Days of week lauspicious for you are Sundays and Mondays. 
       Lucky jewels tobe worn next to the skin are moonstone, cat’s eye and pearls. Fortunate colours are all shades of green, pale shades, also white and yellow. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your birth number are O,B,K and R. 
       They are more easily affected by worry and annoyance than any other class.  As long as things are going smoothly they can get through any amount of work otherwise get easily despondent and melancholy.  Delicacy of skin  is experienced in this number.  Principle herbs for your number are lettuce, cabbage, cucumber, mushrooms, apples,grapes and the juices of all kinds. 
       Important years of your life are 25, 34, 43, 52, 61 and 70.

You come under the cosmic influence of number-8.  Symbolised by the Saturn, number 8 personalities are invariably misunderstood in their lives.  They are of a deep and intense nature with great strength of individuality.  Often appear cold and undemonstrative.  They are warm hearted and zealous in any cause theytake up.  This number is a great one for spiritual advancement instead of material gains/worldly pleasures.  Have qualities of concentration of purpose and deep convictions.  They should guard against being highly sensitive, over catiousness, taking their responsibilities too heavily. 
       People lucky for you are all those born on 8, 17, 26, 4, 13, 22, 31 of any month especially if born between the periods from 21st January to 19th February and from 21st December to20 January.  The persons whose name number adds upto 8, 4 or 1 can also be lucky for you. 
       Lucky dates for you are 8, 17, 26 of lany month. Secondary lucky dates are 1, 10, 19, 28, 4, 13, 22, 31. 
       Days of week auspicious for you are Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays. Fortunate colours are all shades of dark grey, black dark blue and purple. 
       Lucky jewels tobe worn next to the skin are dark tonned saphire, amethyst besides black pearl, black diamond. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your number are F, P, D, M and T. They are prone to trouble with the liver, bile and intestines besides headaches and rheumatism.  They should avoid animal food and live on fruit, herbs and vegebtables.  Principle herbs for yor number are ginger, garlic.           Important years of your life are 26,35, 44, 53, 62 and 71.

You come under the cosmic influence of number-9.  Symbolised by the Mars; number 9 personalities have a strong will power, pushing nature and urge to fight in all they attempt in life.  Great courage in continuity of their plans and ideas.  For affection and sympathy they will do almost anything.  They are much resourceful and possess excellent organising ability.  They should guard against being too rash and quarrelsome. 
       People lucky for you are those born on 9, 18, 27, 6, 15, 24 or 3, 12, 21, 30 of any month, especially if born between the periods from 21st March to 19th April or between 21st October and 20th November.  The persons whose name number adds upto 9, 6, 3 can also be lucky for you. 
       Your lucky dates are 9, 18, 27 of every month.  Secondary lucky dates are 6, 15, 24, 3, 12, 21, 30. 
       Days of week auspicious for you are Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays. 
       Fortunate colours are all shades of crimson or red, also all rose tones and pink. 
       Lucky jewels tobe worn next to the skin are ruby, garnets and bloodstone. 
       Letters of alphabet having harmonious vibrations with your number are U, V, W or C, G,L and S. 
       They are prone to fevers of all kinds.  Should avoid rich food, also alchololic drinks or wines.  Principle herbs for your number are onions, garlic, leeks, ginger, pepper and juice of nettles. 
       Important years of your life are 27,36, 45, 54, 63 and 72.
